swsh4.5-1.name: Yanma
swsh4.5-1.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

swsh4.5-2.name: Yanmega
swsh4.5-2.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

attacks.name: Nosedive
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

swsh4.5-3.name: Celebi
swsh4.5-3.description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

abilities.name: Woodland Stroll
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal an Energy card you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

swsh4.5-4.name: Cacnea
swsh4.5-4.description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

swsh4.5-5.name: Tropius
swsh4.5-5.description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

attacks.name: Attach Leaves
attacks.effect: Attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

swsh4.5-6.name: Rowlet
swsh4.5-6.description: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.effect: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

attacks.name: Wind Shard
attacks.effect: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

swsh4.5-7.name: Dartrix
swsh4.5-7.description: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

swsh4.5-8.name: Decidueye
swsh4.5-8.description: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

abilities.name: Deep Forest Camo
abilities.effect: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon-GX.

attacks.name: Splitting Arrow
attacks.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Anchor Anger
attacks.effect: If any of your Grass Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Giga Hammer
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Giga Hammer.

attacks.name: Swinging Chain
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Grass Energy attached to this Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Max Anchor

swsh4.5-11.name: Grookey
swsh4.5-11.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

swsh4.5-12.name: Thwackey
swsh4.5-12.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

abilities.name: Lay of the Land
abilities.effect: If you have a Stadium in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

swsh4.5-13.name: Rillaboom
swsh4.5-13.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

abilities.name: Voltage Beat
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Grass Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh4.5-14.name: Gossifleur
swsh4.5-14.description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

swsh4.5-15.name: Eldegoss
swsh4.5-15.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

attacks.name: Enriching Seeds
attacks.effect: Heal all damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

swsh4.5-16.name: Zarude
swsh4.5-16.description: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

attacks.name: Suctioning Vines
attacks.effect: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

swsh4.5-17.name: Reshiram
swsh4.5-17.description: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

attacks.name: Amazing Blaze
attacks.effect: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Field Runner
abilities.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Max Pyro Ball

swsh4.5-20.name: Horsea
swsh4.5-20.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

swsh4.5-21.name: Kyogre
swsh4.5-21.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

attacks.name: Amazing Surge
attacks.effect: This attack does 80 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

swsh4.5-22.name: Buizel
swsh4.5-22.description: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

swsh4.5-23.name: Floatzel
swsh4.5-23.description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

swsh4.5-24.name: Manaphy
swsh4.5-24.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

abilities.name: Ocean Search
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck, reveal a Pokémon you find there, and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

swsh4.5-25.name: Volcanion
swsh4.5-25.description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

attacks.name: Dynamite Steam
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 120 damage for each heads.

swsh4.5-26.name: Chewtle
swsh4.5-26.description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

swsh4.5-27.name: Drednaw
swsh4.5-27.description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.effect: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

swsh4.5-28.name: Cramorant
swsh4.5-28.description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

attacks.name: Spit-Out Shot
attacks.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

swsh4.5-29.name: Snom
swsh4.5-29.description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh4.5-30.name: Frosmoth
swsh4.5-30.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

abilities.name: Ice Dance
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Water Pokémon.

swsh4.5-31.name: Shinx
swsh4.5-31.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

attacks.name: Under Pressure
attacks.effect: If your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining, this attack does 50 more damage.

swsh4.5-32.name: Luxio
swsh4.5-32.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

abilities.name: Top Entry
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if you drew this Pokémon from your deck at the beginning of your turn and your Bench isn't full, before you put it into your hand, you may put it onto your Bench.

swsh4.5-33.name: Luxray
swsh4.5-33.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.effect: If this Pokémon evolved from Luxio during this turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

swsh4.5-34.name: Rotom
swsh4.5-34.description: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

abilities.name: Roto Choice

attacks.name: Thunder Shock

swsh4.5-40.name: Trapinch
swsh4.5-40.description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

attacks.name: Land's Pulse
attacks.effect: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 10 more damage.

swsh4.5-41.name: Koffing
swsh4.5-41.description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

swsh4.5-42.name: Galarian Weezing
swsh4.5-42.description: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

attacks.name: Severe Poison

swsh4.5-43.name: Spinarak
swsh4.5-43.description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang

attacks.name: Stealth Poison

swsh4.5-46.name: Yveltal
swsh4.5-46.description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

attacks.name: Amazing Destruction

swsh4.5-47.name: Nickit
swsh4.5-47.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

swsh4.5-48.name: Thievul
swsh4.5-48.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

attacks.name: Call for Goons

swsh4.5-49.name: Cufant
swsh4.5-49.description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
